notes: DiscoFlate v3.44.1 — Activation OFF now kills EVERYTHING running: competitions, polls, bonus rounds, winner buttons, award deadlines, timed & capacity events (detached rounds and post blocks included), every command gate, cooldowns and grants — plus all device fires and live minigame views. Activation ON is strictly ordered: the ON message posts first, then its [!command] tokens fire, then timed events release their first rounds (8s safety release). Also: competition editor puts Allow-rerolls and Add-ALL-totals on the parameter row next to Win by.
